The move is stated beyond this one example: entry.json use_when abstracts to 'the program's behaviour branches on a single boolean predicate of the spec' with one pre-proved framed lemma per branch carrying the predicate (or its negation) as premise and sharing the same frame, and the README's opinion paragraph names the transferable discipline (branch lemmas carry the discriminating predicate as premise + identical frame so glue = case_tac + two wp, never unfolding the program). avoid_when is honest and specific: different frames/generalisations (wp won't close), non-exhaustive predicate (third case), unproved branch lemmas. Consequences are accurate: case_tac on a boolean yields exactly two goals and discharges its own exhaustiveness (verified at code:1215-1231), and the branch lemmas must carry the predicate as premise. A verified independent known-use (Copy mode, InitCSpace_SI.thy:1545-1562) recurs the same split, confirmed by reading it. Leaf quality for a bounded prover is stated in substance: 'self-contained', 'closes on its own' by one wp against a named seL4 lemma then clarsimp/metis, each object-slot leaf closing by wp against one _helper lemma. Minor unstated nuance, not an objection: the Copy-mode known-use has a different frame (empty->half vs half->initialised) so its glue needs extra subst/simp, which is itself one of the avoid_when conditions; the known-use claim remains accurate as written.
